findings.claim: MessagePack attributes already present on the formatted type are not honoured. Unless a surrogate is supplied, collection always calls CreateContractlessMembers, which assigns alphabetically ordered string-name keys and includes every public read-write member without inspecting [MessagePackObject], [Key], or [IgnoreMember]. This violates the explicit acceptance criterion for attributed external types and changes their wire contract.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a generator execution test for an external class marked [MessagePackObject], with one member marked [Key(0)] and another public read-write member marked [IgnoreMember], and a formatter using only [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter]. Assert serialization produces an integer-key array containing only the keyed member. The current implementation instead produces a string-key map and includes the ignored member, so the test fails.
